# Will this fair pay for the shaved ice stand?

> Free calculator for shaved ice, lemonade and frozen-treat stands: margin per cup by size, cups to break even, profit on a hot, normal and rainy day, and the most booth fee an event can bear. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
